summary: Pre-stage onboarding script failing for SF satellite office; conditional MFA and docker-gpu group not provisioned
description:
Issue summary: A batch pre-stage onboarding run targeting the San Francisco satellite office failed intermittently when provisioning conditional MFA groups and the docker-gpu linux group. Impact: 14 new hires from the satellite office did not receive MFA enrollment prompts and could not access GPU-enabled Docker resources; laptop image completed but post-install account population was partial. Scope: affects the 2026-03-10 SF hire cohort only.

Observed errors: SCIM job returned 502s for the group-create endpoint and subsequent Okta sync displayed partial membership. Some logs show a 409 unique-constraint violation on group externalId. The provisioning script did not mark users as 'completed', leaving them in HR pending state.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Run /onboard/prestage batch script with --site sf-satellite and --groups "mfa-conditional,docker-gpu" 2) Observe SCIM create_group call to identity service 3) Note intermittent 502 responses and 409 externalId collisions 4) Check Okta console for missing memberships and HR portal pending flag.

Temporary workaround: Manual group creation and membership assignment via console; flagged affected users as completed in HR portal so laptop post-provision tasks can continue.
steps_to_reproduce: Run onboarding prestage with --site sf-satellite and --groups 'mfa-conditional,docker-gpu'
Monitor /onboard/prestage logs for scim.create_group API calls
Inspect identity-service and Okta responses for 502 or 409 errors
Verify HR portal user status remains 'pending' if post-provision hooks fail
comments: Priya Shah (Support): Notified HR and blocked this cohort from finishing enrollment; manual workaround applied to allow laptop provisioning to complete.
Marco Alvarez (SRE): Investigating potential rate-limiting or token rotation causing 502s to identity-service. Temporarily throttled prestage runs while we dig in.
HR: Confirmed 14 users were in 'pending' state; Approved manual completion after confirmation of device image finish.
Engineering: Found a race in onboarding-scripts where group creation and membership assignment run concurrently; externalId uniqueness check missing on retry path.
Marco Alvarez (SRE): Preparing a hotfix and coordination plan for re-running prestage for any remaining users post-fix.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: identity-service (internal SCIM gateway) returned 502 due to short-lived downstream outage; retries were not idempotent and created duplicate externalId attempts.

Observed two code paths: create_group then add_member; when create_group retried it attempted to recreate with same externalId and backend responded 409 which the script treated as fatal instead of proceed-to-lookup.
Auth token rotation occurred at 09:11:50; some prestage workers used stale token and received upstream 401 that surfaced as 502 in gateway logs.
Regression introduced in onboarding-scripts@rev: d4b7c1 (retry logic refactor) — missing idempotency guard for group create on 409 responses.
Related systems: identity-service incident INC-2026-03-10-ONB-07 (short SCIM gateway spike) — tied to increase in provisioning throughput from a third-party vendor sync.
resolution_notes: Applied hotfix: onboarding-scripts@rev d4b7c1 -> d4b7c1-fix-idempotency (PR #482) which treats 409 on group create as 'group exists' and does a lookup+attach flow; added exponential backoff for 502s and guard for token refresh window. Rolled hotfix to prestage workers in prod-us-west at 2026-03-12T03:20Z. Manually reconciled group memberships for the 14 affected users and marked them completed in HR portal. Follow-ups: (1) add unit test coverage for 409 handling, (2) add observability metric for 'group-create-409s', (3) schedule a runbook update and postmortem draft linked to INC-2026-03-10-ONB-07.
next_steps: Merge PR #482 into main and deploy to staging for smoke tests
Add e2e test covering idempotent group creation and membership assignment
Update prestage runbook to include token refresh precheck and failure handling steps
Run reconciliation job for any prestage failures in the last 72 hours
